# Agent Deck

> Terminal session manager for AI coding agents

Agent Deck is a TUI (Terminal User Interface) that manages multiple AI coding agent sessions from a single dashboard. Built with Go and Bubble Tea, it runs on top of tmux.

## Key Features

- **Multi-agent dashboard**: See status (running/waiting/idle/error) of all sessions at a glance
- **Session forking**: Fork Claude Code conversations to explore different approaches in parallel
- **MCP Manager**: Toggle MCP servers per session without editing config files
- **MCP Socket Pool**: Share MCP processes across sessions, reducing memory by 85-90%
- **Global search**: Full-text search across past agent conversations (the Recall index)
- **Git worktrees**: Isolate agent work on separate branches automatically
- **GitHub Issues and PRs**: `SESSIONS │ ISSUES │ PRS` tabs in the TUI for the group's GitHub repo: browse, filter, read conversations and diffs, start a session on an Issue or PR, merge, and live PR state on linked sessions. On by default through the `gh` CLI (must be logged in); `[github] enabled = false` turns it off
- **Multi-tool support**: Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, OpenCode, OpenCode 2 (`opencode2`), Copilot, Crush, Muse Code, Cursor (terminal), Hermes Agent, pi, Oh My Pi, DeepSeek Harness, and custom tools via `[tools.*]` in config.toml (see the Multi-Tool Support table in README.md for what each one gets)

## GitHub Issues and PRs

- Tabs: the TUI's left panel shows `SESSIONS │ ISSUES │ PRS` for the selected group's GitHub (or GitHub Enterprise) repo. `[` / `]` cycle the tabs; `Alt+S` / `Alt+I` / `Alt+P` jump to one.
- Keys on a list: `Enter` body and comments, `d` PR diff (`s` split, `|` / `\` pager), `/` filter (GitHub search syntax), `n` start a session in a worktree with a Prompt Template, `a` attach to the linked session, `m` merge a PR (never bypasses branch protection), `o` browser, `y` copy URL, `r` refresh, `p` / `P` Project / Parent Repository. Every key is a rebindable `forge_*` action in `[hotkeys]`.
- Freshness: the list and the open detail refetch every 60 s while the TUI is in the foreground (`[github] refresh_interval`); a failed refetch keeps them on screen, marked `⚠ stale` with a line saying why. `r` refetches now and re-polls the notification-bar signals. The default `is:open` list reads the repository directly; any other filter goes through GitHub search, whose index can lag new changes by a few minutes.
- Notification bar: a change on a PR linked to a session (checks failing, changes requested, approved, merged or closed) or a new review request marks that session on the bar with the signal's glyph until you attach or jump to it; `[github] signals = false` turns the marks off.
- Requirements and off switch: it calls GitHub only through the `gh` CLI, which must be installed and logged in (`gh auth login`). On by default; `[github] enabled = false` in config.toml removes the tabs, the keys and every `gh` call.

## Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asheshgoplani/agent-deck/main/install.sh | bash
```

Or via Homebrew: `brew install asheshgoplani/tap/agent-deck`
